description: This file defines the interface for a simplistic FIFO queue data structure in C, including its creation, deletion, item management, and iteration functions. It includes typedefs for callback functions used for item cleanup, comparison, and iteration.

methods.name: queueCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a new queue object that must be released via queueDestroy when no longer needed.

methods.name: queueDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the queue and frees associated resources, optionally freeing each item using a custom helper function.

methods.name: queueCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items currently in the queue.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the queue.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queueDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specific item from the queue based on a search value and comparison function, freeing memory if a helper is provided.

methods.name: queueFind
methods.description: Searches for an item in the queue matching the search value using the comparison function.

methods.name: queueIterate
methods.description: Iterates over all items in the queue, executing a callback function for each.

methods.name: queueClear
methods.description: Removes all items from the queue, freeing memory via a helper function if provided.
